crossRefs.note: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may…
Or who is there among you, who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

parallels.note: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

translations.web: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?
translations.bsb: What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
translations.kjv: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
translations.asv: And of which of you that is a father shall his son ask a loaf, and he give him a stone? or a fish, and he for a fish give him a serpent?
